calendarFeed.title: Calendar
calendarFeed.description: Subscribe your calendar (Google, Apple, Outlook…) to a personal link and your confirmed sessions show up without connecting any account. New or changed sessions appear when your calendar app refreshes the subscription.
calendarFeed.copyManual: Select the link and copy it by hand.
calendarFeed.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new link? The current one will stop working and you will need to subscribe again.
calendarFeed.secretHint: Anyone with this link can see your sessions. Don't share it.

howTo.title: How to subscribe
howTo.google: Google Calendar: "Other calendars" → "From URL" and paste the link. Google takes 8 to 24 hours to show changes.
howTo.apple: Apple Calendar: File → "New Calendar Subscription" and paste the link.
howTo.outlook: Outlook: "Add calendar" → "Subscribe from web" and paste the link.
